info.title: Vision Chain Agent Gateway API
info.description: EVM-compatible L1 blockchain with gasless transactions for AI agents. Single POST endpoint with action-based routing. 83 actions across 17 domains.
info.x-catalog: GET /agentGateway is the authoritative action catalog; x-actions is kept in step with it by functions/scripts/sync-openapi.cjs.

BearerAuth.description: API key as Bearer token. Obtain via system.register.

error.example: Insufficient VCN balance for API fee

get.description: Returns full API catalog with all 83 actions, parameter schemas, response fields, error codes, and pricing tiers.

200.description: Discovery JSON with all domains and actions

post.description: Single endpoint for all 83 actions. Set 'action' field to specify which action to execute.

system.register.description: Register a new AI agent. Creates wallet, issues API key, mints SBT identity, funds 99 VCN.

system.network_info.description: Get chain configuration, RPC URL, contract addresses, and current block height.

system.delete_agent.description: Permanently delete an agent and its wallet.

wallet.balance.description: Get VCN balance, RP points, and staking info.

wallet.gas_estimate.description: Estimate gas for an operation (informational only, gas is free).

transfer.send.description: Send VCN to any address. Gasless via Paymaster.

transfer.batch.description: Send VCN to multiple recipients in one call.

transfer.conditional.description: Transfer VCN when a condition is met.

staking.compound.description: Claim rewards and re-stake them atomically.

staking.apy.description: Get current APY and network staking stats.

staking.cooldown.description: Check cooldown status for unstake requests.

bridge.initiate.description: Start cross-chain bridge transfer. 1 VCN bridge fee.

nft.mint.description: Mint an NFT or SBT on Vision Chain.

settlement.set_wallet.description: Set payout wallet address for settlements.

node.status.description: Get node status and tier access.

storage.set.description: Store a key-value pair. Max 10KB per value, 1000 keys per agent.

storage.get.description: Retrieve a stored value by key.

pipeline.create.description: Create a multi-step pipeline for automated workflows.

pipeline.execute.description: Execute a pipeline, running all steps sequentially.

webhook.subscribe.description: Subscribe to real-time event notifications. Max 20 per agent.

webhook.test.description: Send a test event to verify endpoint.

social.referral.description: Get your referral code and stats.
